title: Expose owner-only inquiry list and detail read model
requirements: Add an explicitly injected owner-only read runtime and GET /api/v1/admin/inquiries plus GET /api/v1/admin/inquiries/{id}. Both endpoints require a valid existing owner session and return 401 AUTH_REQUIRED without revealing private data when it is absent or invalid. They are read-only and do not require CSRF.

The list supports status, has_visit and channel filters, stable received_at/id ordering, opaque cursor bound to the active filters, and limit with default 50 and range 1..100. Its InquirySummary contains the fields accepted in docs/api.md section 6, including a calculated cash summary; no contact details or comments are returned in the list.

Inquiry detail returns the accepted owner-only information: contact snapshot and current contact, service selection snapshot, agreed terms, client request, current participation when present, manual cash notes with correction state, calculated cash summary, safe notification summary and allowed_commands as an empty list until command handlers are implemented. Unknown or inaccessible IDs return 404 without a database error body.

Read each list page and detail through a PostgreSQL READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ transaction so joins cannot combine different moments. CashSummary derives only from currently effective cash notes and reports DATA_REVIEW_REQUIRED for a return larger than receipts; it stores no new aggregate.

Add synthetic PostgreSQL integration tests for session protection, list filter/cursor behaviour, private-vs-summary field boundary, detail values, effective correction calculation, notification summary and 404. Tests create isolated random databases and never read a local .env or use a configured source database.
Do not add writes, status commands, visit calendar routes, payment integrations, catalog editing, production runtime composition, secrets or frontend assets.
acceptance: A signed-in owner can browse incoming inquiries and open one full CRM card, while visitors cannot obtain any CRM data.
The returned cash, correction and notification information is a consistent read model of persisted facts and does not change inquiry or visit state.
Focused isolated PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted owner CRM read boundary; it exposes only an authenticated consistent projection of existing inquiry, cash and outbox facts.
